datasets.title: Census state building permits · 2000–2025
datasets.what: Homes given permission to be built each year, by state and building size.
datasets.used: Choose and test the five-year starting point.
datasets.note: Numeric cells are unit counts despite the workbook's thousands heading.

datasets.title: Census state building permits · 2025
datasets.what: Final 2025 counts and reported construction values.
datasets.used: Check each state’s 2025 starting number.
datasets.note: State valuation columns use thousands of dollars; counts use units.

datasets.title: Census county building permits · 2025
datasets.what: Permits and construction values for each county.
datasets.used: Work out county starting points and compare parking or fee savings with building values.
datasets.note: Local CSV includes inherited stock, transit and modeled cost inputs.

datasets.title: Census past county permits · 1990–2025
datasets.what: Yearly county permit counts for buildings with 1, 2, 3–4 or 5+ homes.
datasets.used: Draw the past-permit and building-type graphs.
datasets.note: County codes and coverage change over time; historical boundaries are not harmonized. State/U.S. graph history sums the attached county series and may differ from the state baseline source.

datasets.title: Census homes by building size · B25024
datasets.what: Detached houses, attached houses and homes in larger buildings.
datasets.used: Provide the detached-home count used for ADUs and small-building examples.
datasets.note: Housing units are not verified eligible parcels.

datasets.title: Census population by age · B01001
datasets.what: How many people are in each age group.
datasets.used: Describe who lives in the area and support household calculations.
datasets.note: Population denominators include group-quarter residents.

datasets.title: Census middle age · B01002
datasets.what: The median age: half the people are younger and half are older.
datasets.used: Describe the area’s age profile.

datasets.title: Census household sizes · B11016
datasets.what: How many households have one, two or more people.
datasets.used: Show how many people live together.

datasets.title: Census household income · B19013
datasets.what: The middle household income, in 2024 dollars.
datasets.used: Describe income alongside housing costs.

datasets.title: Census occupied and empty homes · B25002
datasets.what: Homes with residents and homes without residents.
datasets.used: Describe the existing housing supply.

datasets.title: Census owners and renters · B25003
datasets.what: Homes occupied by their owners or by renters.
datasets.used: Count owner and renter households.

datasets.title: Census reasons homes are empty · B25004
datasets.what: Homes for rent, for sale, used seasonally or empty for other reasons.
datasets.used: Keep different kinds of empty homes separate.
datasets.note: Vacant units are not all usable excess supply.

datasets.title: Census householders by age · B25007
datasets.what: Owner and renter households grouped by the main householder’s age.
datasets.used: Describe age differences among households.

datasets.title: Census people per household · B25010
datasets.what: Average number of people living in an occupied home.
datasets.used: Turn population examples into possible household changes.

datasets.title: Census people per room · B25014
datasets.what: Owner and renter homes grouped by how many people share each room.
datasets.used: Count homes with more than one person per room.
datasets.note: Crowding means more than one person per room, not per bedroom.

datasets.title: Census rent by bedroom count · B25031
datasets.what: Typical monthly rent for homes with different numbers of bedrooms.
datasets.used: Describe rents for smaller and larger homes.
datasets.note: Some county/bedroom rent estimates are unavailable.

datasets.title: Census age of buildings · B25034
datasets.what: Homes grouped by when their building was built.
datasets.used: Describe the age of existing homes.
datasets.note: Building age does not establish condition or replacement losses.

datasets.title: Census bedrooms in owner and renter homes · B25042
datasets.what: Occupied homes grouped by bedroom count.
datasets.used: Describe the bedrooms in existing homes.

datasets.title: Census typical monthly rent · B25064
datasets.what: The middle monthly rent among homes where rent is paid.
datasets.used: Keep rent information in the housing data download.
datasets.note: Not used in production or household forecast equations.

datasets.title: Census rent compared with income · B25070
datasets.what: Rent as a share of renter household income.
datasets.used: Count renters spending 30% or 50% or more of their income on housing.
datasets.note: Displayed percentages exclude uncomputed rent-to-income ratios.

datasets.title: Census typical home value · B25077
datasets.what: The middle value of homes lived in by their owners.
datasets.used: Keep home-value information in the housing data download.
datasets.note: Not used in production or household forecast equations.

datasets.title: Census household size and building size · B25124
datasets.what: Household size, owner or renter status, and homes in the building.
datasets.used: Describe which households live in different building sizes.

datasets.title: Census population changes · 2020–2025
datasets.what: Population, births, deaths and people moving in or out.
datasets.used: Explore how many households there might be in 2030.
datasets.note: One revised vintage; local continuations are not official projections.

datasets.title: HUD housing problems · 2018–2022
datasets.what: Housing costs and other problems faced by lower-income renters.
datasets.used: Show existing housing problems, not a count of missing homes.
datasets.note: Rounded county estimates; state/national sums are approximate.

datasets.title: BTS transit stop map
datasets.what: The qualifying transit locations used in the supplied data.
datasets.used: Estimate the share of housing near qualifying transit.
datasets.note: Original stop-selection vintage and source archive were not recovered.

datasets.title: Census boundaries for small areas
datasets.what: Map shapes used with housing counts and transit locations.
datasets.used: Estimate how much housing is within half a mile of qualifying transit.
datasets.note: Original tract archive and exact overlay workflow were not recovered.

datasets.title: State and county map shapes
datasets.what: The outlines displayed on the map.
datasets.used: Let people find and choose a place.
datasets.note: Original display-boundary archive and vintage were not recovered.

datasets.title: California population projections · 2026 edition
datasets.what: Official projections for California and its counties.
datasets.used: Compare our population examples with another projection.

datasets.title: North Carolina population projections · 2025 edition
datasets.what: Official projections for North Carolina and its counties.
datasets.used: Compare our population examples with another projection.
datasets.note: Extracted from the official summary table.

datasets.title: Policy definitions and chosen assumptions
datasets.what: The five policy examples and their Low, Default and High settings.
datasets.used: Define the rules being tested and the numbers we assume.
datasets.note: The handbook defines benchmarks; national response rates remain model assumptions.

research.title: Seattle 2024 ADU Annual Report
research.used: Shows changes in Seattle ADU permits. It does not measure a national take-up rate.

research.title: Massachusetts ADU rules and reported outcomes
research.used: Explains ADU rules and reported results in Massachusetts.

research.title: Land-Use Reforms and Housing Costs · 2023
research.used: Studies housing-rule changes across cities. It does not measure this exact 2–6-home example.

research.title: The Financial Feasibility of Transit-Oriented Development · 2025
research.used: Shows how rents and costs affect building projects near transit.

research.title: Residential minimum parking requirements in Seattle · 2020
research.used: Studies how Seattle builders changed the parking they provided.

research.title: Burge and Ihlanfeldt: Impact fees and single-family home construction · 2006
research.used: Studies how development fees, infrastructure and construction may affect each other.

research.title: Census BPS methodology
research.used: Explains what Census permit counts and construction values mean.

research.title: Census: Homeowner and Rental Vacancies in the ACS · 2026
research.used: Explains how Census calculates the share of homes available to rent or buy.

research.title: HUD CHAS definitions
research.used: Explains HUD housing-problem and income measures.
